biography: As a Program Manager at Microsoft, I drive regulatory engagements with utilities, regulators, and key stakeholders to enable the successful delivery of data center infrastructure while advancing cost optimization, risk mitigation, and sustainability objectives. With over a decade of experience in the energy sector and a strong foundation in engineering and information technology, I bring a unique blend of technical insight and strategic leadership to every initiative. My expertise spans data center interconnection, energy supply contract development, and regulatory navigation across the Americas. I proactively analyze energy market trends and evolving policy landscapes to uncover opportunities that reduce costs, minimize operational risk, and support long-term sustainability goals. I also collaborate with globally distributed teams on site selection and energy project development, including distributed energy resources and renewable integration. In addition to regulatory and energy strategy, I lead initiatives focused on cloud operations and infrastructure, ensuring scalable, resilient, and efficient deployment of digital workloads across Microsoft’s global footprint. I’m particularly passionate about leveraging renewable energy sources to power cloud infrastructure and applying AI-driven load forecasting models to optimize energy consumption and grid interaction. Recognized for my ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs to successful outcomes, I excel at aligning diverse teams, managing stakeholder expectations, and delivering results under pressure. I’m passionate about solving business and technical challenges through innovative thinking and collaborative execution. My leadership style is grounded in transparency, continuous improvement, and empowering others to succeed.
